column1: # English-to-Welsh terminology for locales/cy-001 and locales/cy-gb (cy-gb is a copy of cy-001).
# Source of choices: TermCymru, the Welsh Government term bank (2026-07-02 export, gov.wales).
# source column: "TermCymru A/B/C" = status of the bank entry used (A best); "standard" = not in the bank,
# standard Welsh used; "book" = a convention for this book. The bank's choice wins unless it is the wrong sense.
# Register: formal written Welsh. Keep English acronyms (DAU/MAU, ROI, VOI, HbA1c, PROM, ePROM, SUS, NPS,
# RE-AIM, ISO/TS 82304-2) and give the Welsh expansion on first use. Mind treigladau after feminine nouns and prepositions.
